item.title: Adaptation to Unfavorable Conditions of Growth: Pathogenicity of Acholeplasma Laidlawii PG8
item.description: As a result of cultivation of A. laidlawii PG8 cells on the deficient medium during 480 days, the mycoplasma culture adapted in vitro to unfavorable growth conditions was obtained. The culture consisted of cells with sizes less than 0.2 micres and features of A. laidlawii PG8 ultramicroforms, nanocells. item.title: The Influence of Mycoplasma Infection an Acute Myocardial Infarction
item.description: We studied haemostatic, immunologic and microelement parameters in patients with acute myocardial infarction, some infected with mycoplasma and some not. Clinical patterns of acute myocardial infarction in the mycoplasma-infected patients were also investigated. Infection with mycoplasmas and other microorganisms of the TORCH group may be risk factors for the development of acute myocardial infarction.
